perquisite.definition:
n an incidental benefit awarded for certain types of employment (especially if it is regarded as a right)
n a right reserved exclusively by a particular person or group (especially a hereditary or official right)
perquisite.translation:
n. 额外补贴, 特殊待遇, 外快
[经] 奖金, 小费, 额外补贴

perquisited.translation: n. (工资以外的)额外所得；津贴(尤指按惯例给的补贴)；特殊待遇；特权

perquisites.definition:
n. an incidental benefit awarded for certain types of employment (especially if it is regarded as a right)
n. a right reserved exclusively by a particular person or group (especially a hereditary or official right)
perquisites.translation: n. （工资以外的）财务补贴( perquisite的复数形式 ); 额外收入; （随职位而得到的）好处; 利益

perquisition.definition: n. A thorough inquiry of search.
perquisition.translation:
n. 彻底搜查
[法] 彻底搜查, 详细询问
